description: Origine du risque du PPRi du Val du Louet et de la Confluence de la Maine et de la Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maine-et-loire.gouv.fr. The origin of the risk characterises the real-world entity which, through its presence, represents a potential risk. This origin may be characterised by a name and, in some cases, a geographical object locating the actual entity causing the risk. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Origin of the risk of the PPRi of Val du Louet and the Confluence of Maine and Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2021-03-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
